note: Thresholds and fixture-spec hashes for PERF05-PERF12 (ch.16b section 6.2). Accepted as written; none may be tuned, relaxed or re-interpreted after a failure. Same reference profile as ADR-20261111-002.

declarations.PERF09: investigations, sseClients, slowClients and chartRows are the ch.16b figures. The other values are the bounds the definition leaves 'declared': tenantCap (the supervisor's per-workspace child maximum), queue bounds and timeout, worker pool, the other-tenant p95 factor, buffered-byte and memory bounds, max rows (the gateway's query limit), breaker interval. Set once before the first run; none may be tuned after a failure. otherTenantP95Factor is 3, the value declared first. An informal first measurement of 5.2x led a worker to raise it to 6; the lead reverted that on 2026-11-12 because raising a threshold after seeing a failing measurement is tuning after a failure (ADR-20261111-002). Only an owner-approved amendment may change it.
